_meta.what: Index of the streamed 3D city: tiles to load around the player, plus what is seen from far away.
sources: City of Niagara Falls open data (government): building footprints 2018, sidewalks, rivers, creeks, parks, tree inventory, property parcels (pa address, pm lot m², pp parcel id) and, per parcel id under parcels, zoning, Official Plan, heritage, condominiums, City property, building permits 2015-2023, planning applications
The simulation: businesses, yearly sales, tourist share, vehicles and walkers per day
Estimated: parking lots in front of stores and plazas, from the outline and the nearest road
Natural Resources Canada (government): HRDEM lidar ground heights, Hamilton-Niagara 2021, Open Government Licence - Canada
USGS 3D Elevation Program via the AWS Terrain Tiles (government, public domain): ground heights on the US side
_meta.heights: City 2018 heights; 11 towers set to their published heights (Wikipedia list of tallest buildings, citing The Skyscraper Center), marked hs='published', or added as a 46 x 22 m slab on a large podium (hs='published-slab', approximate outline)

terrain.source: Natural Resources Canada HRDEM lidar, Hamilton-Niagara 2021, bare-earth DTM, Open Government Licence - Canada (government data), read at 8 m, resampled to 10 m; outside the survey (the US side): USGS 3DEP heights via the AWS Terrain Tiles (zoom 15)
